question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

They have decided to visit Konark, __have they__?
solution:
The correct answer is: "**haven't they?**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When the **main clause is affirmative**, the **tag question is typically negative**, and vice versa.
 
• In this case, since the main clause is affirmative ("They have decided to visit Konark"), the tag question should be negative ("**haven't they**").
 
• This maintains grammatical correctness and ensures proper usage of tag questions.
 
• So, the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is "**haven't they**."

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

The **revised sentence** would be: *They have decided to visit Konark, haven't they?*
